an10.115:1.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo, dhammo ca.
an10.115:1.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti.
an10.115:1.5: idaṃ vatvā sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an10.115:2.1: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
an10.115:2.2: “idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:2.5: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabba”nti.
an10.115:2.6: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti.
an10.115:3.2: ‘ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.115:3.3: pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.115:3.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma,
an10.115:3.5: yathā no āyasmā ānando vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā”ti.
an10.115:4.1: atha kho te bhikkhu yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu,
an10.115:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhu āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an10.115:5.1: “idaṃ kho no āvuso ānanda bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho,
an10.115:5.2: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.115:6.1: tesaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
an10.115:6.2: ‘idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho,
an10.115:6.3: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca. adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.115:6.5: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti.
an10.115:7.2: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.115:7.3: pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.115:7.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma,
an10.115:7.5: yathā no āyasmā ānando vyākarissati tathā naṃ dhāreyyāmā”ti.
an10.115:8.1: seyyathāpi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva mūlaṃ atikkammakhandhaṃ sākhā palāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya,
an10.115:8.2: evaṃ sampadamidaṃ āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ bhagavantaṃ atiyitvā amhe etamatthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha.
an10.115:8.3: sohāvuso bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato.
an10.115:8.4: so ceva panetassa kālo ahosi, yaṃ tumhe bhagavantaṃ yeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha,
an10.115:8.5: yathā vo bhagavā vyākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā ti.
an10.115:9.1: addhāvuso ānanda bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati. cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmi tathāgato.
an10.115:9.2: so ceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ mayaṃ bhagavantaṃ yeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma,
an10.115:9.3: yathā no bhagavā vyākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma.
an10.115:9.4: api ca āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.115:9.5: pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.115:10.1: hāvuso suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmī ti. eva
an10.115:10.2: māvusoti kho te bhikkhu āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.115:11.1: yaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:11.4: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabba”nti.
an10.115:12.1: katamo cāvuso adhammo, katamo ca dhammo, katamo ca anattho, katamo ca attho:
an10.115:13.3: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho.
an10.115:13.4: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.115:15.3: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho.
an10.115:15.4: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.115:16.1: yaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:16.2: “adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.115:16.3: tathā paṭipajjitabba”nti. imassa kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
an10.115:16.4: ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumhe āvuso bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha.
an10.115:16.5: yathā vo bhagavā vyākaroti. tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
an10.115:17.1: ’evamāvuso’ti kho te bhikkhu āyasmato ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an10.115:18.1: “yaṃ kho no bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:18.2: “adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.115:19.1: tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
an10.115:19.2: “idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:19.3: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.115:19.5: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā”ti.
an10.115:20.2: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.115:20.3: pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.115:20.4: yannūnamayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmā ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma,
an10.115:20.5: yathā no āyasmā ānando vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmāti.
an10.115:21.1: atha kho mayaṃ bhante yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṃkamimha, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ apucchimha.
an10.115:21.2: tesaṃ no bhante āyasmatā ānandena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi vyañjanehi attho suvibhatto”ti.
an10.115:22.4: mamañcepi tumhe bhikkhave upasaṃkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha, ahampi cetaṃ atthaṃ evameva vyākareyyaṃ, yathā taṃ ānandena vyākataṃ.
an10.115:22.5: eso cetassa attho, evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
